name: Halversen Thermal-Lined Work Vest
description: Sleeveless insulated vest in dark olive quilted nylon, worn as a mid-layer over a work shirt during the brutal Great Lakes winters. The chest is plain except for a small Halversen patch on the collar; the back has a single large internal pocket for a heat pack or comms tablet. Well-used versions are pilled and compressed at the shoulders from heavy jacket wear on top.
functionality: Core insulation layer for outdoor and unheated facility work; snap-front allows fast removal when moving between cold exterior and heated indoor zones.
what_it_says: You've learned the hard way that the lake wind doesn't care what shift you're on.
story_hooks: The internal back pocket is large enough to hold a folded-up document — a worker's vest contains a printed contract amendment their supervisor claimed was never distributed.
A vest left in a break room locker for six months still has a heat pack inside — activated, still faintly warm, with no explanation.

physical_description.visual_profile: A utilitarian sleeveless vest with a straightforward silhouette, designed for layering under heavier outerwear. Projects rugged functionality and working-class authenticity without pretense.
physical_description.fit: Relaxed, comfortable fit through the torso with slightly tapered sides. Allows freedom of movement for industrial or manual labor. Sized to accommodate layering beneath without bulk.
physical_description.primary_material: Dark olive quilted nylon with thermal insulation batting. Durable, water-resistant synthetic that withstands repeated compression and friction.
physical_description.texture: Quilted diamond pattern across the surface with a slight sheen. Well-worn examples show pilling at stress points and compressed quilting at shoulders from jacket abrasion. Interior thermal lining is soft, slightly brushed.
physical_description.color_scheme: Muted dark olive green as primary color. Small gray Halversen woven patch on left chest collar area. Minimal contrast stitching in matching thread.
physical_description.closures: Full-length heavy-duty plastic coil zipper with reinforced slider. Simple, functional—no decorative elements.
distinctive_features: Single large internal zippered pocket across full back panel, sized for thermal heat packs or standard comms tablets
Halversen Workwear Co. woven patch on chest collar—small, understated branding
Reinforced seam binding at armholes and neck opening
Thermal batting visible at worn edges on aged examples
Compression wear marks at shoulders from repeated jacket layering
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3-4 functional workwear. Affordable, durable gear for working-class laborers, warehouse staff, industrial technicians.
physical_description.cultural_context: Signals honest manual labor, cold-climate endurance, unglamorous necessity. Worn by GLMZ infrastructure workers, dock hands, maintenance crews. No affectation—pure pragmatism.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in and weathered. Pilling visible at high-friction zones. Quilting compressed at shoulders. Zipper may show minor corrosion. Interior lining slightly faded. Authentic wear patterns from real use.
